jobs.description:
For a large organisation operating in a complex and highly regulated environment, we are looking for an experienced Senior Azure Cloud DBA Engineer.

The organisation is undergoing a major digital transformation, modernising traditional database platforms and expanding its capabilities within Microsoft Azure.

As a Senior Azure Cloud DBA Engineer, you will play a key role in designing, building, automating, securing and managing modern cloud-based database platforms.

You will be part of a specialised Database Administration & Engineering team, working closely with Cloud Architects, Platform Engineers, Infrastructure Architects, Cybersecurity teams, developers and operations teams.

You combine in-depth knowledge of SQL Server and Azure database technologies with expertise in automation, Infrastructure as Code, DevOps and cloud architecture.

A particular focus will be placed on the further implementation and governance of Cosmos DB, Azure SQL Database and automated database platforms.

Your responsibilities

 
• Azure database platform engineering
  
   
• Design, implement and manage enterprise-grade database platforms within Microsoft Azure.
    
   
• Develop and optimise Azure SQL Database and Cosmos DB services.
    
   
• Integrate database solutions into Azure Landing Zones.
    
   
• Design secure and scalable database architectures.
    
   
• Implement Private Endpoints, Private DNS and network security.
    
   
• Develop High Availability and Disaster Recovery solutions.
    
   
• Manage backup and recovery strategies.
    
   
• Contribute to further cloud adoption and platform modernisation.
    
  
 
• Cosmos DB engineering & NoSQL governance
  
   
• Design, implement and manage Cosmos DB environments.
    
   
• Develop efficient NoSQL data models.
    
   
• Establish standards and governance principles for NoSQL databases.
    
   
• Optimise performance, capacity and cloud costs.
    
   
• Ensure security, documentation and metadata management.
    
   
• Bridge traditional relational database architectures with document-oriented solutions.
    
  
 
• Database administration & Data Security
  
   
• Design and automate data refresh processes for non-production environments.
    
   
• Implement data masking, scrambling and anonymisation techniques.
    
   
• Ensure GDPR-compliant processing of test and development data.
    
   
• Preserve business logic and referential integrity during data transformations.
    
   
• Develop consistent and reusable solutions for SQL Server, Azure SQL Database and Cosmos DB.
    
  
 
• infrastructure as code & DevOps
  
   
• Develop and maintain reusable TerraForm modules.
    
   
• Automate database deployments through Infrastructure as Code.
    
   
• Set up and maintain CI/CD pipelines.
    
   
• Develop PowerShell scripts and automation solutions.
    
   
• Work according to DevOps principles and best practices.
    
   
• Ensure consistent, secure and reproducible deployments across different environments.
    
  
 
• SQL server & performance engineering
  
   
• Act as a senior technical point of contact for SQL Server and Azure SQL.
    
   
• Analyse and resolve complex database performance issues.
    
   
• Perform root cause analyses.
    
   
• Optimise SQL queries and database configurations.
    
   
• Carry out capacity planning and performance analysis.
    
   
• Monitor database...
  
...

 
• You have at least 5 years of relevant experience as a Database Administrator, Database Engineer or Cloud DBA.
  
 
• You have demonstrable experience with SQL Server and database administration.
  
 
• You have extensive experience with Microsoft Azure and Azure Database Engineering.
  
 
• You have hands-on experience with Azure SQL Database.
  
 
• You have experience with Cosmos DB, including data modelling, performance optimisation and governance.
  
 
• You have experience designing and implementing Azure database solutions using TerraForm and CI/CD pipelines.
  
 
• You have strong knowledge of Infrastructure as Code and DevOps.
  
 
• You are familiar with database security, monitoring, troubleshooting and performance tuning.
  
 
• You have strong analytical skills and take ownership of your technical solutions.
  
 
• You can explain complex technical concepts in an understandable way.
  
 
• You are solution-oriented, pragmatic and enjoy collaborating with different technical teams.
  
 
• You have coaching skills and enjoy sharing your knowledge with colleagues.
  

Technical requirements

 
• Database technologies:
  
   
• Microsoft SQL Server
    
   
• SQL Server Administration
    
   
• Azure SQL Database
    
   
• Cosmos DB
    
   
• T-SQL
    
   
• Database Security
    
   
• Performance Engineering
    
   
• Data Modelling
    
  
 
• Microsoft Azure & Cloud:
  
   
• Microsoft Azure
    
   
• Azure Landing Zones
    
   
• Private Endpoints
    
   
• Private DNS
    
   
• Network Security
    
   
• Microsoft Entra ID
    
   
• Managed Identities
    
   
• Azure Key Vault
    
   
• High Availability & Disaster Recovery
    
   
• Backup & Recovery
    
  
 
• Automation & DevOps:
  
   
• TerraForm
    
   
• Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
    
   
• PowerShell
    
   
• GIT
    
   
• Azure DevOps
    
   
• CI/CD Pipelines
    
   
• Deployment Automation
    
  
 
• Monitoring & troubleshooting:
  
   
• Azure Monitor
    
   
• Log Analytics
    
   
• Query Store
    
   
• Extended Events
    
   
• Root Cause Analysis
    
   
• Performance Troubleshooting
    
  
 
• Architecture & governance:
  
   
• Database Architecture
    
   
• Data Governance
    
   
• Security Governance
    
   
• Operational Governance
    
   
• NoSQL Governance
    
  

Nice to have

• Azure SQL Managed Instance

jobs.occupation: Hays - Senior IT Service & Vendor Engineer
jobs.description:
As a Senior IT Service & Vendor Engineer, you will play a key role in ensuring the quality and performance of IT services delivered by external suppliers. Working in an international multi-vendor environment, you will monitor service delivery, challenge vendors and drive structural improvements across IT services.
Your main responsibilities include

• Leading regular supplier service reviews and contributing to quarterly business reviews.

• Monitoring SLAs, service performance, breaches and supplier actions.

• Challenging vendors on performance, root-cause analyses and recurring service issues.

• Identifying opportunities for structural and continuous service improvement.

• Coordinating issues involving multiple IT suppliers and driving them towards resolution.

• Maintaining the SLA framework, service catalogue, vendor register and renewal calendar.

• Validating supplier invoices, cloud consumption and software licensing against contractual scope.

• Supporting contract renewals and amendments.

• Coordinating service transitions when IT services move between suppliers.

• Contributing to service reporting and overall supplier governance.

What you'll get in return

In return for your expertise, you will receive an attractive salary package including

• Gross monthly salary between EUR5,000 and EUR6,100.

• Company car

• Group and hospitalization insurance

• EUR125 NET/month allowance

• Meal vouchers of EUR8 per worked day and EUR250 eco vouchers per reference year

• Bonus potential of 10% of the annual gross salary, subject to the applicable bonus plan

• Laptop and mobile phone/subscription

• 26 holidays

• A 39-hour working week with flexible working hours and time registration

• After the first three months of office-based onboarding, two teleworking days per week, with fixed days agreed with the supervisor. Teleworking from abroad is not possible.

You combine solid experience in IT Service Management, Service Delivery and Vendor Management with a good technical understanding of infrastructure and cloud environments.

• You have at least 10 years of relevant IT experience, ideally within outsourced or multi-vendor environments.

• You have experience in IT Service Management, Service Delivery, Service Integration, Vendor Management and/or Supplier Governance.

• You have a strong understanding of infrastructure, cloud and security, allowing you to challenge external IT suppliers.

• Experience working with offshore, nearshore and multi-vendor environments is an advantage.

• You are comfortable leading service review meetings involving multiple external suppliers.

• You communicate clearly and diplomatically with technical, business and external stakeholders.

• You are structured, proactive, solution-oriented and able to challenge vendors constructively.

• You are fluent in English. Knowledge of Dutch and/or French is an advantage.

• You have a relevant bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.

What you need to do now

Are you interested in this role? Please contact Alexia Brosens from Hays or click 'apply now' to forward an up-to-date copy of your CV, or call us now.

jobs.occupation: Technician in day shift - English is allowed!
jobs.description:
Are you a hands-on technician who's already living in Belgium in the area of Oostkamp-Bruges? Do you have solid knowledge of electricity or electromechanics? And are you looking for a stable job in maintenance work with lots of variety? Then this might be the job for you!

For a growing transport and logistics company in Oostkamp, we are looking for a multi-skilled maintenance technician with a strong background in electrical maintenance or electromechanics to help maintain the buildings, warehouse, technical installations, and outdoor areas of the company. And the best part: Dutch isn't required, so you can also apply if you speak English very well!

Your role

As technician, you play a key role in ensuring the reliability, safety, and operational performance of the infrastructure. You perform both the preventive and corrective maintenance of all the facilities, ensuring the logistical operations keep running safely and efficiently. Electricity is at the heart of the job, but you're also responsible for a wide range of general building maintenance.

Your key duties:

• Perform various kinds of repairs, replacements and maintenance works to the infrastructure of the company
• Carry out preventive technical controls on the various installations
• Keep up the company grounds and outdoor facilities
• Help perform maintenance and repairs to the company vehicles
• Supervise external contractors and service providers
You'll sometimes need to go into the freezer warehouse, of course with the necessary thermal clothing.

Is this you?

• Education and/or experience in electrical maintenance, electromechanics or another relevent technical field
• Able to read electrical diagrams and schematics
• Own transportation to the company (no public transport nearby)
• Very good knowledge of English, both spoken and written
• Already living in Belgium, preferably in the area of Oostkamp or Bruges
Then please don't hesitate to apply, because this job could be yours!

Any other technical skills are a big plus but not obligated, e.g. mechanics, plumbing, HVAC... The company can teach you these on the job.

Already living in Belgium in the area of Oostkamp-Bruges, and looking for a stable logistics job?

Do you enjoy physical work? Do you have experience in a warehouse or logistics environment? And are you comfortable working in a cold environment? Then this could be your next long-term opportunity!

For a leading logistics company in Oostkamp, we are looking for motivated warehouse workers to join the team. You will help distribute frozen food products to supermarkets across Belgium and Europe while working in a modern logistics environment where English is fully accepted.

Your role

As a warehouse worker, you are an important part of the logistics process. Using an electric pallet truck (EPT), you help ensure that products are received, stored and shipped correctly.

Your responsibilities include:

• Loading and unloading trucks
• Performing quality checks on incoming and outgoing goods
• Keeping the warehouse organised and safe
After a while, you can also receive internal reach truck training and expand your responsibilities.

You're a good fit if you:

• Have previous experience in warehouse or logistics
• Have experience with an electric pallet truck (EPT)
• Can work in a 2-shift system
• Aren't afraid of working in cold environments
• Have your own transportation to the company (no public transport nearby)
So please don't hesitate to apply if you meet these requirements!

Reach truck experience is a big plus but not mandatory.

 

!! Please note: you do NOT qualify if you're not already living in Belgium (in the area of Oostkamp-Bruges) and don't have legal permission to work in the country !!

Your mission: WIN NEW BUSINESS!      You will take ownership of new client acquisition in the European (bio)pharmaceutical market.    Your primary goal is to build a strong pipeline, engage decisionmakers and win new contracts for our    QC laboratory services.    You combine disciplined prospecting with consultative selling and confidently drive opportunities from first contact through negotiation and contract signature.
   
• Identify, target and acquire new customers in the European (bio)pharmaceutical sector, with a focus on companies developing and manufacturing small and/or large molecules.  
• Build and execute a proactive account acquisition plan, including cold outreach, networking, referrals, industry events and strategic partnerships.  
• Create and maintain a healthy, qualified sales pipeline and take full ownership of opportunities from lead generation to closing.  
• Lead negotiations, overcome objections and close profitable contracts in line with commercial targets.  
• Represent SGS Pharma laboratory services at conventions, exhibitions, professional associations and targeted networking events.  
• Maintain accurate CRM data, opportunity stages, next actions and forecasts.

• A bachelor's or master's degree in pharmaceutical sciences, life sciences or a related field.  
• At least 3 years of successful sales or business development experience in the pharmaceutical industry, ideally within laboratory, analytical, QC, CDMO/CRO or related services.  
• Good knowledge of regulatory QC requirements, including GMP and FDA expectations.  
• Consultative selling, negotiation and closing skills, combined with a strong focus on measurable commercial results.  
• You stay focused through long sales cycles and do not wait for opportunities to come to you.  
• An entrepreneurial and structured working style, with strong CRM discipline  
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.    Additional European languages are an advantage.  
This is a position for someone who wants to have a real impact on business growth.    You will have the freedom to develop new markets and customers while being backed by experienced experts.
 
You can focus on building relationships, identifying opportunities and closing businesses, while working in a scientific environment where quality, expertise and reliability are key.

Jobomschrijving

For our client in Gijzegem, we are looking for a motivated Maintenance Technician m/f/x to work in a 2-shift system (6:00 AM - 2:00 PM and 2:00 PM - 10:00 PM). Are you technically skilled, eager to learn, and ready to roll up your sleeves? Then you might be the colleague we are looking for!

As a Maintenance Technician, you will be responsible for ensuring the optimal operation of our machinery and production equipment. You will carry out both preventive and corrective maintenance on injection molding machines, peripheral equipment, and testing systems.

In addition, you will contribute to technical improvements and small-scale projects aimed at increasing the reliability and efficiency of our installations. A positive attitude and willingness to continuously develop your skills are just as important as your technical knowledge. Experience with PLC systems is a plus, and further training will be provided internally.

Your Responsibilities

• Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on injection molding machines, peripheral equipment, and testing systems.
• Quickly and efficiently diagnose and resolve faults in electrical, electronic, hydraulic, and mechanical systems.
• Independently execute small technical improvement projects.
• Participate actively in continuous improvement initiatives to enhance machine performance and reliability.
• Help maintain a safe working environment and comply with environmental regulations.
• Contribute to housekeeping and cleanliness standards within the workshop and production areas.

• You have a technical education (A2 level, Associate Degree, or Bachelor's degree in Electromechanics, Electricity, Automation, or equivalent through experience).
• Knowledge of injection molding machines is an advantage.
• Basic knowledge of PLC controls is a plus; additional training can be provided internally.
• You have experience maintaining and repairing industrial machinery and equipment.
• Experience in a manufacturing environment and with preventive maintenance is a strong asset.
• You have a good command of Dutch.
• You can understand technical manuals and documentation in English and/or German.
• You have strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
• You can efficiently solve electrical, mechanical, hydraulic, and pneumatic issues.
• You take a proactive approach and contribute ideas to prevent future breakdowns.
• You are able to work independently on maintenance and repair activities.
• You are service-minded and enjoy collaborating with colleagues across different departments.
• You communicate clearly about technical issues and solutions.
• You work closely with production teams to minimize downtime.

Are you looking for a challenging job within one of the largest food groups in Belgium (pork meat)? Have you always been interested in pork processing and want the opportunity to learn how to debone a pig?                        

 Follow o  ur intensive training program and quickly develop the necessary skills. As a reward for your eagerness to learn, you will receive a permanent contract.
